name: input_setrelationship
about: SetRelationship turns a neutral NPC hostile. CAI_BaseNPC::InputSetRelationship 0x10273790 (the one NPC input on CAI_BaseNPC's own datamap) writes the relationship rows and nothing else: no condition, no forced reselect, no output. 'player' names the player's class row. The next sense pass (PerformSensing 0x10310710 / Look) then sees a hated player in view: SEE_HATE and SEE_ENEMY are set, the enemy record is new, NEW_ENEMY breaks the idle program and SelectIdealState takes the NPC to COMBAT, where a combat program is selected; GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20 fires OnFoundPlayer on the new sighting. Param verbatim from hw_tawni_1 (npc_tawni_boyfriend 'player D_HT 5'). sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg) verbatim. Corrected 2026-10-04 (V2): Hunter1's row faces Source yaw 270 (angles '0 270 0'), so from north the player at 'start' stood 90 degrees off its facing, outside m_flFieldOfView 0.2 (FInViewCone slot 363), and was never seen at all (no SEE_PLAYER in any Hunter1 trace); the player now stands 300 units in front of it (arena (975, 762) cm: the stage turns the row's Source yaw 270 into Unreal yaw 90, ElysiumArenaStage.cpp AuthoredYaw), inside its vision 900, facing it.
notes: The end probe names the committed enemy; the player answers '!player' in this runtime (as sense_bodies_transparent's passing probe reads it; corrected 2026-10-04 by V2 from 'player').
